summary: Align the TypeScript installation with the published 19e Effect-utils producer and record its measured dependency hash

replay.detail: This change aligns build-toolchain inputs and their measured installation hash; it does not modify Fractal store replay or recovery code.

schema.detail: No database tables, indexes, migrations or schema versions are changed.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules, digests or coordinated-member upgrade requirements are changed.

compatibility.detail: The published toolchain also supplies shared CI generators and the telemetry collector. The canonical TypeScript installation hash has been measured for exact producer 19e8869676e66a39bd3b3e0fccf217ad1b5d71ce, but full TypeScript consumer, generated-workflow and release-integration qualification remain required before readiness; this hash measurement does not attest mixed-version runtime compatibility.

downtime.detail: The source and dependency-hash update itself performs no service restart or deployment and introduces no additional required interruption.

manual.detail: Source maintainers updating this toolchain must keep flake and source-member selections aligned, run the native lock update, then scripts/nix-typescript-client-deps-hash --system x86_64-linux --flake . to measure both recorded hash fields. Do not reuse the previous producer's hash. Existing deployed installations require no action from this source-only change.

recovery.detail: No persistent-state migration is introduced. A source rollback must restore the matching toolchain selections, lock metadata and measured installation hash together; the existing hash producer restores its input hash file if evaluation or measurement fails.
